stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Maria Hill approves May's transfer to a desk job after the mission in Bahrain, and May works in Hill's field office until Coulson recruits her. After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, May confronts Hill to find out who ran Project T.A.H.I.T.I., the program that brought Coulson back.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Maria Hill and Natasha Romanoff serve together at S.H.I.E.L.D. under Nick Fury.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: When Hydra surfaces inside S.H.I.E.L.D., Hill rescues Natasha, Steve and Sam from custody and fights beside them to stop Project Insight.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Maria Hill is Nick Fury's right hand at S.H.I.E.L.D. and one of his most trusted friends.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Hill joins Fury when he comes back to Earth to stop the rogue Skrulls. In Moscow she is shot dead by Gravik, who is wearing Fury's face.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Maria Hill and Phil Coulson serve together as Nick Fury's trusted lieutenants at S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Hill leads the Air Force to Coulson's hideout at Providence, hoping a deal will keep his team out of prison. When the soldiers take the team captive, she fights them off and helps Coulson's people escape.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: On Nick Fury's orders, Soren takes Maria Hill's form and fills in for her during the Elemental crisis in Europe, working beside Spider-Man and Mysterio.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Maria Hill helps Steve Rogers take down the Project Insight helicarriers when Hydra is exposed inside S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Hill now runs operations for the Avengers while Steve leads the team in the field.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Maria Hill goes to work for Tony Stark and runs operations for the Avengers out of his tower. She coordinates the team from the raid on Strucker's base to the Battle of Sokovia.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Minn-Erva tries to shoot Maria Rambeau down in a dogfight over Earth, but Maria shoots her down instead.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Monica Rambeau is Maria Rambeau's daughter, a bright young girl who idolizes her mother's best friend Carol Danvers.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Maria dies of cancer while Monica is gone in the Blip, and Monica comes back to find her mother lost.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Nick Fury comes to Maria Rambeau's home with Carol Danvers and joins the fight against the Kree.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Maria Rambeau flies with Carol Danvers to Mar-Vell's hidden lab in orbit, where they find Soren, her daughter G'iah and other Skrull refugees. Maria helps get the Skrulls to safety from the Kree.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Talos first comes to Earth hunting Carol Danvers, and Maria Rambeau treats him as an enemy. Once he turns out to be a refugee, Maria flies the mission to save his people.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Tyler Hayward is a senior S.W.O.R.D. officer under its founding director, Maria Rambeau. After her death he takes over as acting director.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Morgan Stark is Maria Stark's granddaughter, born to her son Tony and Pepper Potts long after Maria's death.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Maria Stark is Tony Stark's mother. Learning that the Winter Soldier murdered her tears Tony and Steve Rogers apart.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Misty works to bring Mariah Dillard to justice for Cottonmouth's death, but Mariah escapes charges by having the only witness, Candace Miller, killed.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty keeps chasing Mariah as she wages a bloody war with Bushmaster, and she finally gets the evidence to take her down when Shades turns on her.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Mariah Dillard and Priscilla Ridley were sorority sisters, and Ridley, now head of the Harlem precinct, comforts Mariah after Cottonmouth's murder.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Ridley works to bring Mariah down, and after Tom Ridenhour's murder she arrests Mariah herself.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Mariah Dillard calls Rosalie Carbone and the other crime bosses to a meeting to work together. Rosalie later turns against her.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Shades helps Mariah Dillard cover up her murder of Cottonmouth, and the two become lovers and partners in crime.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Shades loses faith in Mariah as her war with Bushmaster turns savage. He betrays her and turns witness against her.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Mariah Dillard is Tilda Johnson's mother, and she gave her up as a child. Tilda poisons Mariah in prison.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Police captain Tom Ridenhour, who dated Mariah Dillard in high school, works to bring down her crime family. He questions her, offers her a deal, and is murdered while meeting the informant he hired to spy on her.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Marion James and Rafael Hernandez are old friends, and he sees her as one of the good agents at the CIA. Together they help Madani bring down William Rawlins and offer Frank Castle his freedom in return.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: William Rawlins works under Marion James at the CIA, and she ends up helping bring him down.

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Martha Williams is Simon's mother, and she raises him and his older brother Eric on her own after their father dies when Simon is still a young boy.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Martinex is Stakar Ogord's first mate and longtime teammate in the Ravagers. He stays at Stakar's side after their old team breaks up, and they bring the crew back together after Yondu's death.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Martinex served with Yondu on Stakar Ogord's old crew. When Stakar shuns the exiled Yondu on Contraxia, Martinex shares a silent look with his old teammate before following Stakar out.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Misty clashes with Mary Walker, the unstable mercenary known as Typhoid Mary.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Mary Walker and Ward Meachum go to Turk Barrett for weapons to kill Davos, and Turk sells Mary an M4 rifle with armor-piercing rounds. She knows her guns well enough to correct him on the exact model.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Mary Walker digs up information on Ward Meachum and later goes with him to buy weapons.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Peter Quill bluffs his way past Master Karja by posing as a worker, and Karja ends up venting to him about his annoying subordinate. When Karja's guards later corner the Guardians, Peter hacks their suits and sends Karja flying out of control.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Master Karja leads the Orgosentries who guard the High Evolutionary's Orgoscope. When the Guardians break in to steal Rocket's file, Karja and his guards hunt them through the station on his master's orders.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: As Daredevil, Matt Murdock fights Maya Lopez while she is working as one of Wilson Fisk's enforcers.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Melvin Potter is a gifted craftsman forced to work for Fisk. Matt protects him, and Melvin builds Daredevil's armored suit.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Detective Misty Knight works alongside Matt and the other Defenders during the fight against the Hand.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Mr. Charles is a CIA agent working with Fisk on an illegal weapons deal, which Matt and Jessica Jones blow up.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Murakami is one of the Hand's leaders, whom Matt and the Defenders fight beneath Midland Circle.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Daredevil fights the serial killer Muse to rescue Angela del Toro from his lair.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Nobu, a leader of the Hand, nearly kills Matt in their first fight, and Matt barely survives by setting him on fire.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Nobu returns alive, and Matt faces him again in the war with the Hand over Elektra.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Matt Murdock is Peter Parker's lawyer after Peter's identity is exposed, and he gets the charges against him dropped.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: FBI agent Ray Nadeem first guards Fisk and hunts Daredevil. He later turns on Fisk and helps Matt, until Bullseye kills him.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Matt Murdock questions Ray Schoonover at Frank Castle's trial. Schoonover's sniper attack later nearly kills him and his friends.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: District Attorney Samantha Reyes prosecutes Frank Castle against Matt and Foggy while hiding her own role in his family's deaths.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Soledad Ayala is Hector's widow. Matt defends her husband in court and searches for her niece Angela when she goes missing.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Stick is the blind warrior who trains young Matt after the accident, and he returns years later to pull Matt into his war with the Hand.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Theo Nelson is Foggy's brother and an old friend of Matt's from Hell's Kitchen.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett is a small-time arms dealer whom Daredevil roughs up for information again and again.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Vanessa Fisk is Wilson Fisk's wife. Matt learns she hired Bullseye to kill Foggy and confronts her at the Black and White Ball.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Vladimir Ranskahov blames Matt Murdock for his brother's death and tortures him. Later they are both trapped in a warehouse by the police, and Vladimir helps Matt escape.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Wilson Fisk, the Kingpin, is Matt's greatest enemy, and they fight for control of Hell's Kitchen until Matt helps put him behind bars.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Fisk gets out of prison as an FBI informant and frames Daredevil with an impostor. Matt beats him but spares his life, and Fisk agrees to leave Matt and his friends alone to keep Vanessa free.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Years later Fisk becomes mayor of New York and declares war on vigilantes, and Matt takes up the fight against him for the whole city.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Yusuf Khan is trapped in a bank robbery at New York Mutual Bank alongside Matt Murdock. Matt protects him and the two become friends.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: May Parker is Peter Parker's aunt, who raises him in Queens.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: May dies helping Peter cure the villains from other worlds, and her last words teach him that with great power comes great responsibility.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Maya Hansen comes to warn Tony Stark, and Pepper Potts drags her to safety when the Mandarin's helicopters destroy Tony's home. Maya then reveals she is still working with Aldrich Killian, who takes Pepper captive.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Maya Hansen is a scientist who meets Tony Stark in Bern in 1999, where he leaves her an equation to help perfect Extremis after they spend the night together. Years later she comes to him for help with Extremis.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Skully, an old friend of Maya's family who runs a pawn shop in Tamaha, welcomes her home and builds her a new prosthetic leg. He also tells her about Chafa, the first Choctaw, from whom her family's power descends.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Taloa Lopez is Maya Lopez's mother. She dies in a car crash when Maya is a child.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Tuklo is one of Maya's Choctaw ancestors, whose story she sees in visions.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Wilson Fisk raises Maya Lopez as a surrogate uncle and employs her in his crime empire. When she learns he had her father killed, she shoots him.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Fisk survives and comes to Oklahoma to win Maya back, but she uses her family's power to break his hold on her for good.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Mel is Valentina Allegra de Fontaine's assistant, but she grows uneasy with her boss's schemes. In the end she quietly tips off Bucky Barnes against her.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Melina Vostokoff posed as Natasha Romanoff's mother in their undercover family in Ohio. In the end she helps Natasha bring down the Red Room.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Melina seems to betray her family by calling Taskmaster to her farm to capture them for the Red Room. It is a ruse, and once inside she frees Alexei and locks Taskmaster in a cell.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Melina is a veteran Black Widow who goes on to create the chemical mind control that Dreykov uses on the Widows. In the end she turns on him and helps her daughters set the Widows free.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Melina Vostokoff raises Yelena as her daughter during the undercover mission in Ohio. Yelena resents her for helping build the Red Room's mind control, but Melina sides with her daughters in the end and helps free the Widows.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Mike Peterson knocks May out while the Centipede serum is making him unstable, and later fights her team as Hydra's Deathlok.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Once Mike is free of Hydra, he joins the team in the fight to rebuild S.H.I.E.L.D., though May keeps her distance at first.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Nick Fury brings Melinda May back to the field with a secret job: build Phil Coulson's team and report on how Coulson is recovering from his resurrection. When Coulson finds out she has been reporting to Fury all along, he stops trusting her for a time.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson and Melinda May are old friends who have trusted each other for decades.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: As Coulson's life runs out, their feelings for each other finally come out, and May stays with him in Tahiti for his last days.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Piper volunteers for the mission to stop Hive and rescue Daisy, fighting under May's lead.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: May trains Piper in hand-to-hand combat and leads the strike team she serves on under Director Jeffrey Mace. Piper stays a loyal friend through the years that follow.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Melinda May hunts Raina, the Centipede agent who kidnaps people with powers, starting in Hong Kong.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: May stands guard as Raina tries to blackmail Coulson into handing Skye over to her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: When Robert Gonzales' S.H.I.E.L.D. takes over the Playground, May slips past his agents, storms his office, and shoots him with an I.C.E.R. She later takes a seat on his council to help bring the two sides of S.H.I.E.L.D. together.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Rosalind Price's ATCU takes in Andrew Garner after he turns into Lash, and she offers May the chance to put him in a medical coma to slow the change. May agrees after asking Daisy what she would do.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Sif teams up with May to recapture the escaped sorceress Lorelei, and the two warriors bond over Sif's sword. Sif warns May that Lorelei once enchanted a man she cared for and urges her to be ready to do what is needed about Grant Ward.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Sunil Bakshi, disguised as Glenn Talbot, lures May into his hotel room, ties her up, and threatens to torture her for S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets. She breaks free and attacks him, and later she and Coulson hand him over to the real Talbot.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Years ago in Russia, Melinda May steals an 0-8-4 from Anton Ivanov's unit, and his comrades are executed for the failure. Now calling himself the Superior, he blames May and Phil Coulson and wants them dead.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Victoria Hand takes command of the Bus while Coulson is missing, and May backs her decision to put Skye off the plane. During the Hydra Uprising, Hand takes over the Bus herself, unsure whose side May and the team are on.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Werner von Strucker tries to kill May's ex-husband Andrew Garner on Grant Ward's orders. When May finds Werner being tortured by Kebo, she frees him, holds him as he bleeds, and learns from him that Garner has become Lash.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Wilson Fisk forces Melvin Potter to make armor and gear for him by threatening his friend Betsy.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Mephisto makes a deal with Riri Williams. She asks for her A.I. back, but he twists the bargain and returns her dead friend Natalie instead.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Parker Robbins struck a pact with Mephisto, who gave him the cloak that powers the Hood. The cloak slowly corrupts Robbins the longer he wears it.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Meredith Quill is Peter Quill's mother, who dies of cancer when he is a boy.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Quentin Beck tries to kill Michelle Jones because she knows about his illusions.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Michelle Jones starts out calling Ned and Peter losers at the lunch table, but she becomes one of Ned's closest friends.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: After Peter's identity is exposed, she and Ned stand by him through the multiversal crisis. Even after the world forgets Peter, the two stay close and head off to MIT together.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Michelle Jones is Peter's sharp, aloof classmate on the academic decathlon team, and she tells him her friends call her MJ.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Peter plans to tell MJ how he feels on the class trip to Europe. She works out that he is Spider-Man, and the two fall in love.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: MJ stands by Peter after his identity is exposed. To save the world, Peter has everyone forget him, including her, and he chooses not to tell her who he was.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Years later Spider-Man saves MJ from a telepath, and she learns he is the Peter Parker she has forgotten. She cannot return his love without her memories, but she lets him back into her life as a friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Roger Harrington is MJ's teacher, and he names her captain of the academic decathlon team when Liz Allan leaves. He chaperones the trip to Washington, often caught off guard by her pointed remarks, like her refusal to enter a monument built by slaves.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: The Grandmaster forces Miek to fight in his Contest of Champions on Sakaar. Once freed, Miek helps Korg lead the gladiators in a revolt against him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Deke Shaw tracks down Mike Peterson while searching for agents still loyal to S.H.I.E.L.D., and Mike flies in with them to help save the Lighthouse. At Fitz and Simmons' wedding, Deke asks him which side he is on, and Mike says he knows them both.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Edison Po works on Garrett's Centipede project, which uses Mike Peterson as a test subject.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Under HYDRA's control, Deathlok ambushes Felix Blake during the hunt for the Clairvoyant and breaks his spine. When Blake begs him to remember his son Ace, Deathlok answers that Mike Peterson is dead.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Ian Quinn oversees Mike Peterson's Deathlok upgrades for the Clairvoyant. When Quinn pushes him to kill outside his orders, Mike refuses, saying she is not the one he is supposed to kill.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Jemma Simmons creates the cure that stabilizes the Extremis in Mike Peterson's body and saves his life.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Once Mike is free of Hydra and joins Coulson's fight, she and Fitz test him and prepare him for missions.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: During the battle at Cybertek, Hydra forces Deathlok to turn his weapons on Nick Fury and Phil Coulson. Once Mike breaks free of John Garrett's hold, he kills Garrett while Fury looks on.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson's first mission with his new team is to find and help Mike Peterson, a factory worker made unstable by the Centipede serum.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Hydra rebuilds Mike as the cyborg Deathlok and turns him against Coulson's team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: After Mike escapes Hydra's control, Coulson brings him into S.H.I.E.L.D., and Mike later rescues Coulson from Robert Gonzales' agents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Raina recruits Mike Peterson into the Centipede Project, promising a treatment that will put him back to work after his injury. Her program turns him into one of HYDRA's super soldiers.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Deathlok locks the brainwashed Sunil Bakshi in the trunk of a car and drives him to Coulson for the plan against HYDRA. He then poses as Bakshi's bodyguard so they can get close to Dr. List.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Minn-Erva holds Nick Fury at gunpoint when the Starforce captures him and Carol's allies aboard Mar-Vell's lab, then orders him and the Skrulls ejected into space.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Minn-Erva hunts Talos and the Skrulls as part of Starforce. She chases the Quadjet carrying Talos and his people until Maria Rambeau shoots her down.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Minn-Erva is Starforce's sniper and serves under Yon-Rogg's command. In 1989 she flies with him to Earth to capture Mar-Vell and her light-speed engine, the mission that ends with Carol Danvers absorbing its power.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Miss Minutes and Mobius work side by side at the TVA, but she distrusts him and later works against him.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Miss Minutes runs most of the Temporal Loom's work while Ouroboros only checks in for diagnostics every few hundred years. When she sabotages the effort to save the Loom, Ouroboros reboots the system to shut her down, and he later reprograms her to help the new TVA.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Miss Minutes is the TVA's clock mascot, and she helps Judge Ravonna Renslayer keep the agency running.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: After He Who Remains dies, Miss Minutes and Renslayer go rogue together, hunting for Victor Timely and plotting to take back the TVA.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Miss Minutes helps Renslayer string Sylvie along with a search for a Void timecraft that does not exist. She later appears to Sylvie and Loki at the Citadel at the End of Time, offering them a deal from He Who Remains.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Miss Minutes tries to steer Victor Timely toward becoming He Who Remains. He refuses to go along with her.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Misty is a friend of Pop's and greets him warmly when her investigation brings her to his barbershop. She is shaken when he is killed in the shooting there, and attends his funeral.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Inspector Priscilla Ridley is Misty's commanding officer in the Harlem precinct.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Rafael Scarfe takes Misty on as his partner when no other detective will work with her, teaching her everything she knows about police work. She is shattered to learn he has been on Cottonmouth's payroll, and he dies apologizing to her.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Misty spends years trying to bring down Shades, who kills Candace Miller, the witness she needs against Mariah Dillard.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Misty keeps hunting Shades as he runs Mariah's operations, until he turns on Mariah and hands Misty the evidence to arrest her.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Tilda Johnson helps Misty at first, but she turns out to be dangerous.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Captain Tom Ridenhour was Misty's commanding officer and supported her until his death.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Misty runs into Turk Barrett outside Pop's barbershop and warns him off, surprised to see him so far from Hell's Kitchen. She later finds him where Luke left him and arrests him yet again.

stages.title: Iron Fist S2
stages.text: Misty and Colleen turn to Ward Meachum when Danny goes missing, and he puts Rand Enterprises security on the search. When he bursts in on Misty fighting at Eden Towers and shoots her attacker, she thanks him and he tells her to call him Ward.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Zip and his crew open fire on Misty Knight and Luke Cage during the attack on Harlem's Paradise. Luke shields Misty behind the bar as Zip keeps shooting and complains that Luke is bulletproof.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Mitchell Carson and Peggy Carter are S.H.I.E.L.D. leaders when Hank Pym quits in 1989. Carson wants Pym stopped from leaving with his formula, and Peggy asks if he really wants to make Pym an enemy.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Ouroboros, the TVA's repair technician, once shared a friendly bond with Mobius, who nicknamed him O.B., but Mobius forgets him over the centuries. When they meet again, O.B. happily reminisces while Mobius pretends to remember, and the two work together to save the Temporal Loom.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Ravonna Renslayer is Mobius's superior and longtime friend, and she reluctantly lets him recruit Loki. When the case exposes the TVA's lies, she has Mobius pruned to protect the agency, and he escapes the Void to confront her.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Renslayer escapes the TVA and races Mobius and Loki to reach Victor Timely in 1893. When Mobius confronts her, she insists she has always put the TVA above her own happiness.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Mobius hunts Sylvie as the TVA's most dangerous variant and captures her on Lamentis-1. After he learns the TVA's lies and is pruned, he picks her up in the Void and backs her plan to enchant Alioth.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Mobius takes Victor Timely to the TVA and works with him to fix the Temporal Loom.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Mole Man is a former enemy of Reed's team who becomes an ally and helps them during the crisis with Galactus.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Sue Storm wins over the Mole Man, a former enemy, and he becomes a friend who helps the team.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Nick Fury meets Monica Rambeau as a young girl in 1995, when he and Carol Danvers hide out at her mother's home.

stages.title: The Marvels

stages.text: Morgan Stark is the daughter of Tony Stark and Pepper Potts. Tony gives his life so she can grow up in a world that survived Thanos.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Quentin Beck poses as a hero to win Peter Parker's trust, then tries to kill him. With his last act he frames Peter and reveals his identity.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Quentin Beck fools Talos, who is posing as Nick Fury, with his illusions.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Quentin Beck invents a holographic technology at Stark Industries, and Tony Stark rebrands it and fires him. Bitter at being cast aside, Beck becomes Mysterio and schemes to take Tony's legacy for himself.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: William Riva is Quentin Beck's partner and helps run the illusions behind Mysterio.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: N'Jobu is Ramonda's brother-in-law, the younger brother of her husband T'Chaka. When N'Jobu's son Erik Killmonger arrives in Wakanda, Ramonda calls him a liar until he produces N'Jobu's royal ring.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: N'Jobu is Shuri's uncle, killed by her father T'Chaka years before she is born. T'Challa later brings her to the Oakland building where it happened, which he turns into Wakanda's first outreach center.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: N'Jobu is T'Chaka's younger brother. T'Chaka kills him when N'Jobu betrays Wakanda.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: N'Jobu is T'Challa's uncle, killed by T'Chaka for betraying Wakanda.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: N'Jobu is King T'Chaka's brother, which makes him the great-uncle of Toussaint through his father, T'Challa. He dies long before Toussaint is born.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: N'Jobu recruits Ulysses Klaue in 1992 and secretly helps him steal a quarter ton of vibranium from Wakanda, hoping to arm oppressed people around the world. The raid kills many Wakandans, and T'Chaka confronts N'Jobu for being Klaue's man on the inside.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Zuri poses as N'Jobu's friend in Oakland while secretly spying on him for T'Chaka. When Zuri is exposed, N'Jobu draws a gun on him, and T'Chaka kills N'Jobu to save him.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Najma kills Waleed during the Clandestines' raid on the Red Daggers' hideout.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Nakia rescues Shuri and Riri Williams from Talokan and kills one of its guards. Namor answers by attacking Wakanda.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Nakia and Okoye are old friends who clash over where their duty lies. When Erik Killmonger takes the throne, Okoye refuses to flee with Nakia out of loyalty to the crown, but they fight side by side once T'Challa returns.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Nakia gets Queen Ramonda and Shuri to safety when Erik Killmonger takes the throne and leads them to the Jabari.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Years later, after T'Challa's death, Ramonda seeks Nakia out in Haiti to help rescue Shuri from Talokan.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Nakia sneaks into Talokan and rescues Riri and Shuri from Namor's guards.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Nakia and Shuri are close friends who fight side by side when Erik Killmonger seizes the throne.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: After T'Challa dies, Nakia rescues Shuri from Talokan and later introduces her to Toussaint, the son Nakia had with T'Challa.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Nakia is a War Dog spy and the woman T'Challa loves, and she pushes him to open Wakanda up to the world.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Nakia and T'Challa have a son, Toussaint, and after T'Challa's death she raises him in Haiti, away from the throne.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Toussaint is the son of Nakia, who raises him in Haiti away from the throne.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Nakia joins the Busan mission to capture Ulysses Klaue and chases him across the city with Okoye until his sonic arm blasts their car apart. Once he is caught, she talks T'Challa out of killing him in front of the crowd.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: W'Kabi opposes Nakia's hope of opening Wakanda to refugees, warning T'Challa against it. He later backs Erik Killmonger, and his Border Tribe traps Nakia and her allies behind energy shields at Mount Bashenga.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Nakia Bahadir confronts Sadie Deever when Damage Control tries to search the mosque, and fights her agents at Coles High.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Nakia Bahadir runs for the mosque board, and she stands with Sheikh Abdullah to stop Damage Control from searching the mosque without a warrant.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Nakia Bahadir and Zoe Zimmer were close as children, drifted apart and become friends again.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namor is the king Namora has idolized since childhood. She serves as his second-in-command and close advisor.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Okoye is stripped of her rank after Namor's warriors take Shuri on her watch in Boston. She returns as Midnight Angel to fight his Talokanil at sea.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namor floods Wakanda's capital in his attack on the country. Queen Ramonda drowns in the attack while saving Riri Williams.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namor wants Riri Williams dead because her vibranium detector threatens Talokan's secrecy. Wakanda refuses to hand her over, which starts his war on Wakanda.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namor takes Shuri to Talokan and shows her his kingdom, hoping to make her an ally. After he kills Queen Ramonda, Shuri defeats him in battle and spares him in exchange for peace.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namora joins the Talokanil ambush on Okoye, Shuri and Riri Williams in Cambridge. She hands Attuma the water bomb he deflects into Okoye, sending her off the bridge just as Shuri is taken.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namora helps kidnap Riri Williams and takes her to Talokan, because Namor wants the inventor of the vibranium detector dead.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Namora guards Shuri during her captivity in Talokan and fights Wakanda's forces in the war that follows.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Natalie Washington is Riri's best friend, killed in the same drive-by shooting as Riri's stepfather. Riri builds her A.I. in Natalie's image, and Natalie later returns through Mephisto's deal.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Natalie Washington is Xavier's sister, and the two grow up hanging around Gary Williams's auto shop with their friend Riri. After Natalie is killed in a drive-by shooting, Xavier listens to her old mixtape whenever he wishes he could talk to her.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Nathaniel is named after Natasha, his parents' close friend and the children's honorary aunt. Clint and Laura first plan to call their baby Natasha, and send her a video of the newborn.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Nebula serves in the Avengers that Natasha leads in the five years after the Snap. On the time heist, Natasha travels with Nebula, Clint and Rhodey before they split up for Vormir and Morag.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Nick Fury is Natasha Romanoff's director at S.H.I.E.L.D., and he sends her undercover to keep an eye on Tony Stark.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Fury is one of the few people Natasha fully trusts. When Hydra is exposed, she fights at his side to bring S.H.I.E.L.D. down.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Okoye and Natasha first fight side by side against Proxima Midnight to save Wanda in Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Okoye joins the Avengers under Natasha's command while still leading the Dora Milaje.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Natalie Rushman brings Pepper Potts the paperwork for her promotion to CEO, and Tony hires Natalie on the spot as his assistant, to Pepper's annoyance. Pepper has no idea Natalie is really Natasha Romanoff, sent by S.H.I.E.L.D. to watch Tony.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Phil Coulson and Natasha Romanoff are S.H.I.E.L.D. colleagues who work the Tony Stark assignment together.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: When Loki takes Clint Barton, Coulson pulls Natasha out of an interrogation to bring her in.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Natasha fights Proxima Midnight in Edinburgh to rescue Wanda and Vision. They clash again in Wakanda, where Proxima nearly kills her and Okoye before Wanda throws her into a Thresher.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: As Vormir's Stonekeeper, the Red Skull tells Natasha Romanoff and Clint Barton that the Soul Stone demands a life. Natasha sacrifices herself.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Rick Mason is Natasha Romanoff's old friend and supplier, who gets her whatever she needs while she is on the run.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Rocket spends five years as a member of the Avengers under Natasha's command. He flies her, Steve and Rhodey on their first trip into space to confront Thanos.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Natasha and Sam fight alongside Steve Rogers to expose Hydra and stop Project Insight.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: After the Sokovia Accords split the Avengers, they spend two years on the run together with Steve.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Scott and Natasha land on opposite sides of the fight over the Sokovia Accords and trade blows at the airport battle.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Five years after the Snap, Scott turns up at the Avengers Compound and pitches Natasha and Steve the idea of a time heist.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Natasha keeps nudging Steve to ask out his neighbor Sharon, who turns out to be Agent 13, sent by Fury to watch over him.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: In Berlin, Natasha and Sharon fight side by side against a brainwashed Bucky.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Steve Rogers and Natasha Romanoff first fight side by side in the Battle of New York.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: They go on the run together when Hydra takes over S.H.I.E.L.D., and they become close friends.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Steve and Natasha hold the remaining Avengers together for five years, until Natasha gives her life on Vormir.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Natasha meets T'Challa at the Sokovia Accords signing in Vienna and promises him that his father's killer will be caught. At the airport battle, she turns on Tony's side and stuns T'Challa so Steve and Bucky can escape.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Taskmaster hunts Natasha Romanoff for Dreykov. Natasha frees her from his control.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Thaddeus Ross presents the Sokovia Accords to the Avengers, and Natasha signs them. When she helps Steve and Bucky escape at the airport, she becomes a fugitive from Ross.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Ross leads the manhunt for Natasha while she is on the run, though he lets it go after she brings down the Red Room.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Natasha Romanoff fights Thanos's army in Wakanda to keep the Mind Stone out of his hands.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: To undo the Snap, Natasha sacrifices herself on Vormir so the Avengers can claim the Soul Stone.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Natasha was trained as a Widow in the Red Room before she defected. When Dreykov sends the Widows after her and Yelena, they free them from his chemical mind control and bring down the Red Room together.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Natasha Romanoff goes undercover as Natalie Rushman, Tony Stark's assistant, to assess him for S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Tony and Natasha fight side by side as Avengers in the Battle of New York and become teammates for years.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap they reunite for the time heist, and both give their lives to defeat Thanos.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Ultron captures Natasha Romanoff and holds her in Sokovia until Bruce Banner rescues her.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Natasha and Steve Rogers train Vision as part of the new Avengers after Sokovia.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: When Thanos's Black Order comes for the Mind Stone, Natasha fights to protect Vision in Edinburgh and Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Before Wanda switches sides, she traps Natasha in nightmarish visions of the Red Room. After Sokovia, Natasha and Steve Rogers train Wanda as part of the new Avengers team.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Yelena Belova and Natasha Romanoff were raised as sisters in a fake family. They reunite as adults and take down the Red Room together.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: On Titan, Nebula joins Peter Parker and the others in pinning down Thanos. When Thanos pulls a moon down on them, Peter webs Nebula, Quill and Drax to safety.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Nebula is one of Ronan's lieutenants, chasing Gamora and Quill across the galaxy for the Orb.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula comes after Gamora again on Ego's planet, but she ends up fighting beside Quill and the Guardians against Ego before leaving to hunt Thanos.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Nebula joins the fight against Thanos on Titan, and her revelation that Thanos killed Gamora sends Quill into a rage.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Nebula, Drax and Mantis find Phyla and the other captive children aboard the High Evolutionary's ship. After the rescue, Nebula stays on Knowhere to help raise them, and Phyla pulls her in to dance.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Proxima Midnight and Nebula are both adopted daughters of Thanos, though Nebula despises her and the rest of the Black Order.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Nebula and Rocket are the only Guardians to survive the Snap, and they spend the next five years as Avengers together.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: After the Blip they are teammates on the Guardians, and Nebula fights to save Rocket's life when Adam Warlock wounds him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Thanos assigns Nebula to Ronan the Accuser to help him get the Orb. When Ronan turns on Thanos and keeps the Power Stone for himself, Nebula sides with him out of hatred for her father and fights for him over Xandar.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Scott tells Nebula she looks awesome when they meet at the Avengers Compound, and she calls him an idiot. She helps Bruce Banner fit him into a Time Suit for the time heist.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Nebula joins Steve Rogers and the surviving Avengers after returning to Earth with Tony Stark. She leads them to Thanos on his garden planet and goes on the Time Heist.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula joins Taserface's mutiny against Yondu, stopping Taserface from killing Rocket and shooting Yondu's control fin off. Once she has a ship, she leaves the Ravagers to hunt down Gamora.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Thanos adopts Nebula and replaces parts of her body each time she loses to Gamora, and she grows to hate him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Thanos catches Nebula sneaking aboard his ship and tortures her until Gamora gives up the Soul Stone's location. Nebula escapes and joins the fight against him on Titan.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Nebula leads the Avengers to Thanos and helps them defeat him in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: The High Evolutionary captures Nebula, Drax and Mantis aboard his ship and threatens them to make Quill hand over Rocket. Nebula fights with the Guardians to bring him down and free his captives.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Nebula and Tony Stark are left behind on Titan together after Thanos wins.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Stranded in space on the way home, Nebula and Tony become friends, and she plays paper football with him to pass the time.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula sides with Taserface's mutiny against Yondu and shoots the control fin off his head. Later they end up on the same side in the battle against Ego.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Ned Leeds is Peter Parker's best friend from school. Once he learns Peter's secret, he helps him from behind a computer as his guy in the chair.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Ned helps Peter face the villains from other worlds. To save the world, Peter has everyone forget him, and Ned says a tearful goodbye to his best friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Years later Ned, who no longer remembers Peter, tracks Spider-Man's sightings with an app he built. He finally meets the hero face to face, and then meets Peter again.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Roger Harrington is Ned's teacher and coaches the academic decathlon team Ned competes on, chaperoning the team's trip to Washington for Nationals.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Doctor Strange brings Ned and MJ to the Sanctum to help round up the visitors from other universes, and Ned surprises him by opening portals with the Sling Ring. One of those portals frees Strange from the Mirror Dimension, and Ned and MJ then talk him into giving Peter's plan a chance.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon is Gravik's lieutenant among the Skrull rebels and warns him that Nick Fury is back on Earth. During the attack on President Ritson, he drags Gravik away after Fury shoots him.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Phil Coulson is one of Nick Fury's most trusted agents at S.H.I.E.L.D., working under him from 1995 on.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: After Loki kills Coulson, Fury secretly brings him back through Project T.A.H.I.T.I. When S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Fury makes Coulson director of a new S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Raava, posing as James Rhodes, uses her position to undercut Nick Fury. Fury kills her when he unmasks her.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Robert Gonzales joins S.H.I.E.L.D. young under Nick Fury and commands the Iliad when Hydra rises. He first insists on following Fury's order to blow up the ship, but later admits that doing so would have killed hundreds of agents.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Nick Fury assigns Agent 13, Sharon Carter, to protect Steve Rogers by posing as his next door neighbor. She is on guard the night the Winter Soldier ambushes Fury in Steve's apartment.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Sonya Falsworth is Nick Fury's old friend and fellow spy at MI6. She helps him hunt the Skrull rebels while pursuing Britain's own interests.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Soren is Talos' wife, one of the Skrull refugees Nick Fury helps escape the Kree in 1995.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Soren now works for Fury, and while he is away in space she poses as Maria Hill on Earth to cover for him.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Nick Fury is the first to greet Steve Rogers when he wakes up in the present after decades in the ice.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Fury recruits Steve into S.H.I.E.L.D. and the Avengers, and Steve works his missions despite distrusting Fury's secrets.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: When Hydra comes for Fury, he turns to Steve, and together they bring S.H.I.E.L.D. down.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Talos and Nick Fury become friends in 1995, after Fury helps the Skrulls escape the Kree.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Talos now works for Fury, posing as him on Earth while the real Fury is away in space.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Fury comes back to Earth to help Talos stop Gravik's rebel Skrulls, though Talos resents that Fury never found his people a home. Talos dies at Gravik's hands before the fight is over.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Nick Fury approaches Tony Stark about the Avengers Initiative after Tony goes public as Iron Man.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Fury calls Tony in to fight Loki, and despite their clashes over S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets, Tony becomes one of the founding Avengers.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Varra, a Skrull who lives as Priscilla, is Nick Fury's wife. Their marriage is strained by his long absences and secrets.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Yon-Rogg leads the Kree soldiers who corner Nick Fury, Carol Danvers and their allies in Mar-Vell's hidden lab and take them prisoner. Fury breaks free and escapes with the Skrull refugees as Yon-Rogg tries to stop their ship.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Nikki Ramos helps expose Todd Phelps as HulkKing, the leader of Intelligencia.

stages.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
stages.text: Nikki Ramos tracks down Wong for Jennifer and later calls him for help when Blonsky leaves his monitored area.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Stick has spent his life fighting the Hand, and Nobu is one of its leaders in New York. After Matt Murdock defeats Nobu, Stick cuts off his head so he cannot rise again.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Nobu represents the Hand in Fisk's alliance and pushes him to clear the tenants from a building the Hand wants. Fisk lures Daredevil into a fight with Nobu that ends with Nobu burning.

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: Noni is sent to bring back the Lion, a rogue War Dogs captain who stole Wakandan weapons. She infiltrates his kingdom and fights him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Peter Quill warns the Nova Corps that Ronan is coming to destroy Xandar. Nova Prime Irani Rael chooses to trust him despite his criminal record and leads Xandar's defense alongside the Guardians.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Nova Prime Irani Rael is Rhomann Dey's commanding officer. Dey brings her Peter Quill's warning that Ronan is coming for Xandar, and she trusts his judgment enough to act on it.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Nova Prime Irani Rael leads Xandar's defense when Ronan the Accuser comes to wipe out her planet with the Power Stone. She orders the Nova Corps to form a blockade around his ship, and with the Guardians' help Xandar survives.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Pepper Potts discovers Obadiah Stane's betrayal, and she triggers the reactor overload that kills him.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Obadiah Stane hires Raza's Ten Rings cell to kill Tony Stark. Later he betrays Raza and takes the armor for himself.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Obadiah Stane is Tony Stark's mentor at Stark Industries. Secretly he pays to have Tony killed, then steals his armor design and fights him as the Iron Monger.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: William Ginter Riva is the Stark Industries scientist Obadiah Stane puts in charge of copying Tony Stark's arc reactor for his own armor. When Riva says it cannot be done, Stane snaps that Tony built one in a cave with a box of scraps.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Odin is Thor's father and the king of Asgard, and he banishes Thor to Earth for his arrogance.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Thor and Loki find Odin dying in Norway, and before he fades away he tells his sons he loves them.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Valkyrie was one of Odin's elite Valkyrior, and she lost her sisters when Odin sent them against Hela. After the massacre she abandons Asgard for good.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Okoye and Natasha Romanoff take on Proxima Midnight when she tries to kill Wanda Maximoff during the Battle of Wakanda. Proxima overpowers them both until Wanda throws her into the path of a Thresher.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Okoye serves Queen Ramonda as general of the Dora Milaje. When Shuri is captured by the Talokanil on Okoye's watch, Ramonda strips her of her rank.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Okoye and Shuri come to MIT to bring Riri Williams to safety, and Okoye blocks her escape through the bathroom.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Okoye guards Shuri, and the two tease T'Challa together like family.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: When Shuri is taken by the Talokanil on Okoye's watch, Okoye loses her rank, but she returns to fight beside Shuri as a Midnight Angel in the war against Talokan.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Okoye fights beside Steve Rogers in the Battle of Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: In the years after the Snap she keeps in touch with Steve's Avengers, and she joins them again in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Okoye serves King T'Chaka in the Dora Milaje. He trusts her to watch over his son T'Challa on missions, and she carries that loyalty over when T'Challa becomes king.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Okoye leads the Dora Milaje, the king's guard, and is T'Challa's closest protector. When Killmonger takes the throne she stays loyal to it at first, then joins T'Challa when he returns to win it back.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Okoye leads the Dora Milaje in tracking Ulysses Klaue to a casino in Busan, where his vibranium sale turns into a trap. She ambushes his bodyguards and joins the car chase through the city to catch him.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: W'Kabi is Okoye's husband. They end up on opposite sides when he backs Killmonger.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: In the Battle of Wakanda, Wanda saves Okoye and Natasha from the Threshers, and Okoye asks why she held back so long. Okoye and Natasha then step in to save Wanda when Proxima Midnight moves to kill her.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S2
stages.text: Oscar Arocho is Vido's father, raising him after a prison stint for forgery and fighting to keep him when Vido's mother Sonia tries to take him away. Vido's admiration for Jessica, who saves his life, draws Oscar close to her.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Will Simpson is a former colleague of Clemons's on the force, and he kills Clemons while hunting Kilgrave.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Ouroboros learned TVA science from Victor Timely's writings and idolizes him. Once Timely comes to the TVA, the two work together and grow close.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon serves in Gravik's rebellion against Talos and tries to kill him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Ray Krzeminski is one of the SSR agents who belittle Peggy Carter, sneering at her ties to Howard Stark and Captain America. Peggy is still shaken when he is murdered, and she suspects a Leviathan-trained woman killed him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Roger Dooley is Peggy Carter's chief at the SSR and mostly keeps her on desk duty. When the evidence points to her helping Howard Stark, he has her interrogated and fires her, but he comes to believe her warning about Ivchenko just before Fennhoff takes over his mind.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Rose Roberts mans the front desk of the SSR's New York office and is friendly with Peggy Carter from the start.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: In Los Angeles, Peggy pushes Daniel Sousa to bring Rose on the Roxxon mission, giving Rose her first field assignment.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Rufus Hunt is sent to kill Peggy Carter. She and Jarvis capture and interrogate him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Sasha Demidov is a silent Leviathan assassin who murders Peggy Carter's roommate Colleen while hunting for a Nitramene bomb. Peggy fights him twice and finally beats him atop the milk truck carrying Leet Brannis.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Peggy Carter is Sharon Carter's great-aunt, and Sharon follows her into intelligence work. When Peggy dies, Sharon speaks at her funeral, which is how Steve learns who she is.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Peggy Carter confronts Spider Raymond at his nightclub about the stolen weapon.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Peggy Carter and Steve Rogers fall in love during the war, but he is lost in the ice before their promised dance.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Steve finds Peggy alive but frail in the present, and he visits her as her memory fades.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the final battle, Steve travels back in time to finally have that dance and spend his life with her.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Vernon Masters shuts down Peggy Carter's planned raid on the Arena Club with an executive order and an audit of the SSR. He spends his time in Los Angeles shielding the Council of Nine from her investigation.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Peggy Carter investigates Whitney Frost, the actress and hidden genius who draws power from Zero Matter. Peggy fights to stop her from tearing open a rift to the dark dimension.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Phil Coulson keeps approaching Pepper Potts to set up a S.H.I.E.L.D. debriefing with Tony, and the two become friendly.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Pepper Potts is Tony Stark's devoted assistant, and the two grow closer as he becomes Iron Man.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Tony makes Pepper the head of Stark Industries, and after the battle at the Stark Expo they finally admit their feelings.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap, Tony and Pepper marry and raise their daughter Morgan, until Tony gives his life to defeat Thanos.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: When the Guardians mistake him for one of Thanos's men on Titan, Peter Quill holds Peter Parker at gunpoint. Once they sort it out, the two fight Thanos side by side.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Roger Harrington teaches Peter at Midtown High and coaches the academic decathlon team, happily welcoming him back for Nationals. Spider-Man saves him and the team from the falling Washington Monument elevator.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Peter Parker and Sam Wilson first meet as opponents at the airport battle over the Sokovia Accords, where Sam takes him on with missiles and his drone Redwing.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Years later they fight on the same side in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Peter Parker and Scott Lang meet as opponents at the airport battle, where Scott kicks Peter to win back Steve's shield and Peter brings down his giant form with webbing.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Years later they fight on the same side in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter rescues Stephen Strange from Ebony Maw's ship and fights beside him against Thanos on Titan.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Years later, Peter asks Strange to make the world forget he is Spider-Man, and his meddling with the spell breaks open the multiverse.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Peter Parker first meets Steve Rogers in battle, when Tony Stark brings him to the Leipzig airport and he snatches Steve's shield.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Years later they fight on the same side in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter Parker fights Thanos on Titan and fades away in Tony Stark's arms after the snap.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Adrian Toomes, the Vulture, sells stolen alien tech and fights Peter Parker when Peter tries to stop him. He figures out Peter is Spider-Man, Peter saves his life anyway, and Toomes keeps his secret in prison.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Tony Stark recruits Peter Parker, gives him his first high-tech Spider-Man suit and becomes his mentor. Peter looks up to him almost like a father.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter stows away to fight Thanos at Tony's side on Titan, and he fades away in Tony's arms after the Snap.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Five years later Peter returns to fight beside Tony in the Battle of Earth, and he is with Tony when he dies.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: William Ginter Riva works for Quentin Beck and helps run the drone illusions behind Mysterio. After Beck dies, Riva sends doctored footage to The Daily Bugle that frames Peter Parker for murder and reveals his identity to the world.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
stages.text: Yelena, now working as Black Widow, is an ally of Spider-Man, and they have traded numbers. She tells him someone is attacking Damage Control facilities in search of V-Max, and later learns from redacted Damage Control files that Sara is Jean Grey's sister.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Peter Quill's Guardians rescue Phyla and the other children from the High Evolutionary's ship.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Peter Quill hunts Theel for the override code that can save Rocket and ends up killing him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rhomann Dey has arrested Quill before and teases him by calling him "Star-Prince." When Quill warns that Ronan is coming for Xandar, Dey vouches for him to the Nova Corps.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket and Groot first try to collect the bounty on Peter Quill, and the three end up founding the Guardians of the Galaxy together. Quill and Rocket bicker constantly but become close friends.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Quill leads the Guardians' desperate mission to save Rocket's life, and afterward he hands Rocket leadership of the team before going home to Earth.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Peter Quill distracts Ronan with a dance-off, and the Guardians then use the Power Stone to destroy him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: On Titan, Quill and Stephen Strange first face off, each thinking the other works for Thanos, then join forces to ambush him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Taserface serves in Yondu's Ravager crew while Peter grows up there, and resents how Yondu keeps protecting Peter even after he betrays the clan. That grudge fuels Taserface's mutiny, and he orders the Ravagers to hunt down and kill the Guardians.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter Quill attacks Thanos on Titan after learning he killed Gamora, which ruins the plan to take the Gauntlet. Quill is later wiped out by the snap.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: The Sovereign hire Peter Quill and the Guardians to stop the Abilisk, a giant space monster feeding on their batteries, and they kill it.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: The Collector offers four billion units for the Orb, and Peter Quill and his crew bring it to him on Knowhere. The deal falls apart when his servant Carina grabs the Infinity Stone inside and it destroys much of his museum.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Quill leads the Guardians against the High Evolutionary to save Rocket's life. Confronting him at his base, Quill calls out the flaws in his Counter-Earth, and the Guardians go on to defeat him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter Quill feels threatened when the Guardians pick Thor up in space and starts deepening his voice to compete.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: After the war with Thanos, Thor travels with the Guardians, and the two part as friends.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter Quill and Tony Stark meet in a standoff on Titan before realizing they are both fighting Thanos. Their plan to pull off the Infinity Gauntlet falls apart when Quill learns Gamora's fate and attacks Thanos in a rage.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Yondu Udonta takes Peter Quill from Earth as a boy and raises him as a Ravager. When the grown Quill cuts him out of the deal for the Orb, Yondu hunts him across the galaxy, then lets him go after the battle of Xandar.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Yondu reveals he kept young Peter from his father Ego, and he gives his life to save Peter, who finally sees him as his real father.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sersi and Ikaris visit Phastos at his home in Chicago and convince him to rejoin the Eternals.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Piper joins Phil Coulson's task force to take out Hive, telling him her gun's safety was never on.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Years later she lures his team into General Hale's trap at a Kree beacon. When Coulson tells her to pick a side, she turns back to S.H.I.E.L.D.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Raina has Centipede kidnap Phil Coulson and puts him in a memory machine to dig out the secret of his return from the dead, until Skye rescues him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Raina tries to blackmail Coulson into helping her get the Diviner.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Phil Coulson first tracks Robbie Reyes, the new Ghost Rider, as a dangerous killer, but learns he lives by a code. They team up against Eli Morrow and Aida, and Coulson even makes his own deal with the Spirit of Vengeance to stop Aida.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Robert Gonzales leads the rival S.H.I.E.L.D. that seizes Coulson's base and demands his Toolbox of secrets. Once Coulson proves himself, they agree to merge their factions, and Gonzales is killed soon after while trying to make peace with the Inhumans.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Rosalind Price leads the ATCU, and she and Phil Coulson start a romance. Grant Ward kills her, which drives Coulson to revenge.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ruby Hale helps capture Phil Coulson for her mother and does her best to get under his skin, but nothing she does rattles him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Phil Coulson picked Sebastian Derik as one of the test subjects for Project T.A.H.I.T.I., and the alien treatment drives Derik to kill the others. When Coulson comes to stop him, Derik ties him up, and they fight before Coulson's team arrives.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Phil Coulson shoots Sinara in the shoulder just as she is about to take Daisy Johnson into custody on the Lighthouse.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Phil Coulson idolizes Captain America and collects his vintage trading cards, and he is the S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who helps bring Steve Rogers onto the Avengers. Loki kills Coulson before Steve can sign the cards, and his death helps unite the team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Sunil Bakshi and Agent 33 move against Phil Coulson's team over a painting carved with alien writing. Coulson chases Bakshi down, knocks him out and takes the painting, and later hands him over to Glenn Talbot.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Years ago in Russia, Phil Coulson and Melinda May slip away from Anton Ivanov's unit with an 0-8-4, and Ivanov's comrades are executed for the failure. Now calling himself the Superior, he blames Coulson and hunts him.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Phil Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. team seizes the crater around Mjolnir and catches Thor when he breaks in to reclaim it. Thor comes to respect him.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Coulson stands up to Loki on the Helicarrier, and his death there hits Thor hard.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Phil Coulson is the S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who keeps trying to debrief Tony Stark after his escape from Afghanistan.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Coulson keeps an eye on Tony for Nick Fury, and Tony slowly warms to him.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Coulson's death on the Helicarrier pushes Tony to fight Loki as an Avenger.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Victoria Hand clashes with Phil Coulson over sending his people into South Ossetia without telling them there is no extraction, and she later suspects his team of serving Hydra. Once she sees they are loyal, she works with him to retake the Hub.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Phil Coulson's team captures Vin-Tak, and Coulson questions him with Sif on the Bus. The Kree restores Sif's memory and explains the Diviners, then turns on Skye as soon as he learns she is Inhuman.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Phil Coulson captures Werner von Strucker and interrogates him to find Gideon Malick, driven by revenge for Rosalind Price's murder. Broken by his ordeal, Werner begs Coulson to just kill him.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Phineas Mason is Adrian Toomes's engineer, and he builds the crew's alien-tech weapons.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Rocket rescues Phyla from the High Evolutionary's ship and later leads her in the new Guardians of the Galaxy.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: The High Evolutionary experiments on Phyla, one of the Star Children he holds on his ship.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Pietro Maximoff fights the Avengers on Ultron's side until he and his sister turn against the robot. He then fights under Steve Rogers in the Battle of Sokovia, where he is killed.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Tommy is the nephew of Pietro Maximoff, Wanda's speedster twin, and shares his super speed.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Pietro Maximoff hates Tony Stark for the Stark shell that killed his parents and joins Ultron against him. He switches sides and fights with Tony's Avengers in the Battle of Sokovia, where he dies.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Pietro and Wanda join Ultron to take revenge on Tony Stark, then abandon him once they learn he wants to wipe out humanity. In Sokovia, Pietro is killed by gunfire from Ultron's jet while shielding Clint Barton and a child.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Pietro Maximoff is Wanda's twin brother, and the two are held in Hydra's labs as Baron Strucker's test subjects.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Pietro fights at Wanda's side, first for Ultron and then with the Avengers. He dies in Sokovia saving Clint Barton, leaving Wanda alone.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ruby Hale counts on Piper to lure S.H.I.E.L.D. to the Kree beacon, then attacks everyone there with her robot soldiers. Seeing Ruby's betrayal, Piper switches sides and helps the agents escape.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Tone, acting on Turk Barrett's tip, opens fire on Pop's barbershop to get Chico Diaz and kills Pop instead. Furious at losing Pop, Cottonmouth throws Tone off a roof.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett spends his days playing chess in Pop's barbershop, and when he learns Pop is sheltering Chico Diaz, he tips off Cottonmouth's men. That tip leads to the shooting that kills Pop.

stages.title: Luke Cage S2
stages.text: Tom Ridenhour takes over Priscilla Ridley's precinct when she is promoted to deputy chief. After he is killed, Ridley returns to lead it and sees his murder answered when she arrests Mariah Dillard.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Sam Wilson flies into the fight in Edinburgh and kicks Proxima Midnight through a café's security gate to save Wanda and Vision. He faces her army again in Wakanda, where he helps destroy one of the giant war machines she sends.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Proxima Midnight is about to rip the Mind Stone from Vision in Edinburgh when Steve Rogers arrives with Sam Wilson and Natasha Romanoff. Steve fights her off and drives the Black Order away, and he faces her again in Wakanda when she demands Vision's surrender.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Proxima Midnight leads Thanos' army to Wakanda and demands that T'Challa hand over Vision. He refuses, warning that Thanos will get nothing but dust and blood, and she answers that they have blood to spare before the battle begins.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Proxima Midnight is Thanos' adopted daughter, an orphan he raises from a conquered world to fight in the Black Order. She hunts the Mind Stone for him in Edinburgh and leads his army against Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Proxima Midnight and Corvus Glaive ambush Vision in Edinburgh to take the Mind Stone for Thanos, leaving him badly wounded. In Wakanda, she sends Glaive and Cull Obsidian after him again.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Proxima Midnight attacks Wanda Maximoff and Vision in Edinburgh. Wanda kills her in Wakanda.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Quaz reads Scott Lang's mind when the freedom fighters bring him in, and mocks what he finds.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Veb and Quaz are fellow freedom fighters who question the Langs together and are captured together during the battle.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Raava, still disguised as Rhodes, tries to have Sonya Falsworth killed.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Rafael Hernandez, Madani's superior at Homeland Security, surprises Sam Stein by already knowing his name. After the botched raid on the Greek Mob, Hernandez works with Stein to trace who hacked their systems.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Rafael Hernandez backs Madani's push to expose William Rawlins, and with Frank's help they uncover Rawlins's conspiracy with Billy Russo. Hernandez is there when Rawlins's battered body is carried away.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Queen Ramonda shelters Riri in Wakanda. When Namor floods the city, Ramonda dies saving Riri from drowning.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Ramonda is Shuri's mother, and the two flee to the Jabari together when Erik Killmonger takes the throne.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Ramonda and Shuri grieve T'Challa together, and Shuri is devastated when Ramonda dies saving Riri Williams.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Ramonda is T'Chaka's wife and the Queen of Wakanda, and together they raise T'Challa and Shuri. At T'Challa's coronation she tells her son that his father's spirit is with them.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Ramonda is T'Challa's mother and Wakanda's queen mother, and she stands by him as king.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: After T'Challa's death, Ramonda takes the throne herself.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Ramonda is Toussaint's grandmother, the mother of his father T'Challa.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: W'Kabi hands Ramonda the royal ring that proves Erik Killmonger is N'Jobu's son, then backs Killmonger's rule while she is forced into exile.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Ravonna Renslayer arrests Sylvie as a child for being a variant, but Sylvie escapes the TVA and spends her life on the run. Years later Sylvie captures Ravonna and holds her at sword point, demanding the truth about who created the TVA.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Ravonna Renslayer and Miss Minutes come to Victor Timely in 1893 and try to use him for their own plans. He later turns against them.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Roger Dooley is Ray Krzeminski's chief at the SSR and leads him and the other agents on the Spider Raymond case. When Krzeminski is murdered, Dooley blames Howard Stark and redoubles the hunt for him.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Ray Nadeem arrests Rosalie Carbone at her charity gala as part of the FBI roundup Wilson Fisk has set up against his rivals. He steps in to take her himself, keeping Benjamin Poindexter away from her.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Seema is Ray Nadeem's wife and the mother of their son Sami, and their money troubles weigh on Ray throughout his work on Fisk's case. She is left a widow when Fisk has Ray killed.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Tammy Hattley is Ray Nadeem's boss at the FBI, and Wilson Fisk has forced her to serve him. She puts Nadeem in charge of Fisk's transfer and then pressures him to keep obeying Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Vanessa meets Ray Nadeem while he works for Fisk. Fisk has Nadeem killed after he turns on them.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Wilson Fisk blackmails FBI agent Ray Nadeem into serving him, until Nadeem records a dying declaration exposing Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Ray Schoonover shoots District Attorney Samantha Reyes dead with a sniper rifle during a meeting.

stages.title: The Punisher S1
stages.text: Ray Schoonover and CIA officer William Rawlins run Operation Cerberus together and fund it with heroin. When Frank Castle threatens to expose it, they sign off on the massacre of his family.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Raza captures Tony Stark and orders him to build a Jericho missile, but Tony builds his first Iron Man suit and escapes instead.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Razor Fist, one of Wenwu's enforcers, attacks Shang-Chi on a San Francisco bus. He later fights alongside him at Ta Lo.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Razor Fist is one of Xu Wenwu's top Ten Rings operatives. Wenwu sends him to San Francisco to take Shang-Chi's pendant, and Razor Fist then leads the raid on Xialing's Golden Daggers Club to take hers.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Razor Fist fights Xialing in Ta Lo on Wenwu's side. After Wenwu dies, he serves her as the new leader of the Ten Rings.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
