stages.text: Razor Fist attacks Ta Lo on Wenwu's side, but he switches sides when the Soul Eaters break free. Ying Nan saves his life in the battle.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Recorder Theel helped the High Evolutionary turn young Rocket into a cybernetic test subject, and he carries the code needed to save Rocket's life.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Recorder Theel serves the High Evolutionary as one of his scientists. He helps carry out the cruel experiments that created Rocket.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Steve Rogers, as Captain America, is the Red Skull's great enemy. He brings down HYDRA's war machine and fights Schmidt on board the Valkyrie.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Tesseract banishes him to Vormir, the Red Skull serves as the Stonekeeper and guides those who come for the Soul Stone, including Thanos.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: The Howling Commandos tear down Johann Schmidt's HYDRA bases one after another.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: The Silver Surfer, herald of Galactus, comes to announce Earth's doom. Reed's team fights her before she finally turns against her master.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Sue Storm is Reed's wife and teammate in the Fantastic Four. They become parents to Franklin.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Wanda attacks Kamar-Taj to reach America Chavez and tries to kill Rintrah in the battle.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Wong is Rintrah's teacher and leader at Kamar-Taj, and he saves Rintrah during Wanda's attack.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Ronnie Williams is Riri's mother, and they grieve the deaths of Riri's stepfather Gary and her best friend Natalie together.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Shuri tracks Riri down at MIT and protects her from Namor. They become friends, and Shuri helps her build a better suit.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: The Hood recruits Riri Williams into his crew of thieves, and she joins to pay for her suit. After a heist goes wrong and his cousin John dies, he turns violent, and she fights him with armor enhanced by magic.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Xavier Washington is Natalie's brother and Riri's close friend, who helps her get around Chicago.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Zelma Stanton is a young sorceress who befriends Riri. She enchants Riri's armor so she can fight the Hood.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Ghost Rider tears through the Superior's robot bodies and wraps his chain around Anton Ivanov so Quake can bring him down.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket crashes the Milano into Ronan's Dark Aster, bringing it down on Xandar. When Groot dies shielding the Guardians in the crash, Rocket attacks Ronan in grief and is blasted aside.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Rocket teases Scott at the Avengers Compound, patting him on the head like a puppy when he gets excited about space. Both take part in the time heist to undo the Snap.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Rocket meets Steve Rogers in Wakanda and fights alongside him against Thanos' army.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Rocket stays with Steve's Avengers after the Snap and joins the time heist.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Taserface captures Rocket and mocks him, and Rocket ends up blowing up his ship.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Teefs is Rocket's friend and cage mate in Batch 89. Rocket tries to free him, but the guards shoot him.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket helps bring the Orb to the Collector and bluntly demands to be paid in units.

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: Years later the Guardians buy Knowhere from the Collector, and Rocket helps rebuild it.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: The High Evolutionary created Rocket in his experiments and nearly killed him. He wants Rocket back for his mind, and Rocket stops him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Rocket goes with Thor to Nidavellir to forge Stormbreaker, and the two bond over everything they have lost.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Rocket helps drag a grieving Thor out of his exile in New Asgard, and they travel to Asgard in 2013 together on the time heist.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Rocket joins Tony Stark and the surviving Avengers after the Snap, and they work together on the Time Heist and in the Battle of Earth. Rocket is among the mourners at Tony's funeral.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Rocket threatens to blow up Yondu's ship to get Quill back.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: After Taserface's mutiny Rocket and Yondu escape together, and Yondu's talk about pushing people away helps Rocket see himself. They fight side by side against Ego, where Yondu gives his life for Quill.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Ronan the Accuser serves the Supreme Intelligence as a Kree commander.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Ronan the Accuser wages the Kree war against Talos and the Skrulls. In 1995 he arrives above Earth to wipe out the last Skrull refugees with ballistic missiles, until Carol Danvers destroys them and forces him to retreat.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Ronan the Accuser works for Thanos in exchange for the destruction of Xandar. Then he turns on Thanos.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Ronan the Accuser kills The Other when he comes to Ronan with Thanos's orders.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Ronan the Accuser works with Yon-Rogg's Starforce during the war on the Skrulls.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Zelma Stanton uses a spell to teleport Ronnie and Riri to safety in her hidden room in another plane.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Rosalie Carbone congratulates Vanessa at her wedding to Fisk and deals with the Fisks' empire.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Rosalie Carbone is a crime boss who buys into Fisk's offer when he returns to power. She pays him a share of her business.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Ruby Hale and Werner von Strucker were childhood friends and become lovers. She accidentally kills him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Whitney Frost hires Rufus Hunt to kill Peggy Carter, then absorbs him into Zero Matter.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Ruth Bat-Seraph distrusts Sam Wilson at first, but she joins him to uncover Samuel Sterns' plot and becomes his friend.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Ruth Bat-Seraph knows that Samuel Sterns is held at Camp Echo One, and she helps Sam and Joaquin escape the soldiers he controls there.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Ruth Bat-Seraph serves as President Ross's national security adviser and is one of his most trusted aides, kept in on secrets like Samuel Sterns's imprisonment. She believes Ross has become a better man and stays at his side even when Sam Wilson confronts him.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Sheikh Abdullah stops Sadie Deever's agents from searching his mosque without a warrant, and later stalls them to protect Kamran.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Sadie Deever interrogates Zoe Zimmer about Night Light after the AvengerCon incident.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Samuel Sterns plots against President Ross and comes up against Sam Wilson as Captain America.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sarah is Sam Wilson's sister. They fight to save their parents' fishing boat in Louisiana, and she backs him when he takes up the shield.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Scott breaks into the new Avengers facility and beats Sam in a fight by shrinking inside his suit.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Impressed, Sam recommends him to Steve Rogers, and Scott joins their side over the Sokovia Accords.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Sharon helps Sam and Steve get their gear back while they are on the run over the Sokovia Accords.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Years later, Sam and Bucky find her hiding in Madripoor, and Sam wins her a pardon for helping them stop the Flag Smashers, not knowing she is the Power Broker.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Sidewinder leads SERPENT in a fight with Sam Wilson over stolen adamantium. Later the two briefly end up on the same side.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sam Wilson and Steve Rogers meet while running in Washington and quickly become close friends, and Sam joins his fight against Hydra.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the final battle, an aged Steve hands Sam his shield and asks him to carry it on.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: During the chase through a Bucharest tunnel, Sam tries to slow T'Challa down as he hunts Bucky, and they are all arrested together.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Sam fights alongside T'Challa in Wakanda against Thanos's army.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: After the Sokovia Accords fight, Thaddeus Ross has Sam locked up in the Raft.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Years later, as President, Ross asks Sam, now Captain America, to rebuild the Avengers. When Ross turns into the Red Hulk, Sam fights him and talks him down.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Sam Wilson fights Thanos and his forces in Wakanda to protect Vision, but Thanos completes the Snap and Sam turns to dust.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Brought back five years later, Sam flies into the Battle of Earth against Thanos' army.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Sam Wilson joins the new Avengers that Tony Stark helps build after Sokovia.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: They take opposite sides on the Sokovia Accords and fight at the Leipzig airport, and Sam ends up locked in the Raft.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Sam and Tony fight together again in the Battle of Earth.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Sam and Vision join the new Avengers together after Sokovia.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: They end up on opposite sides over the Sokovia Accords, and at the Leipzig airport a blast Vision aims at Sam brings down Rhodey instead.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: When the Black Order comes for Vision, Sam and Steve's fugitive team rescue him in Edinburgh.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Sam and Wanda join the new Avengers together after Sokovia. In Lagos they fight Crossbones's mercenaries side by side, and both take Steve Rogers' side over the Sokovia Accords.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Samuel Sterns hires Seth Voelker, known as Sidewinder, and his SERPENT mercenaries to steal adamantium so he can frame President Ross. When Captain America gets too close, Sterns sends Sidewinder to kill him.

stages.title: Captain America: Brave New World
stages.text: Thaddeus Ross blames Samuel Sterns for the Abomination and keeps him locked away at Camp Echo One for years, forcing him to work for him. When Ross breaks his promise to free him, Sterns takes revenge by drugging him and turning him into the Red Hulk.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Sana Ali is Yusuf's mother-in-law, the mother of his wife Muneeba, and she does not attend their wedding. Yusuf still loves telling the family story of how Sana found her father during the Partition by following the stars.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Sara pounds Wanda with Kamar-Taj's cannons during her siege. When Wanda begins dreamwalking through the Darkhold, Sara destroys the book at the cost of her own life.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Sara is a sorcerer of Kamar-Taj who fights beside Wong when the Scarlet Witch attacks. When Wong cannot reach the Darkhold, Sara destroys it herself and burns away in the process as he watches in horror.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Sasha Demidov, Leviathan's voiceless assassin, follows Peggy Carter to La Martinique and kills Spider Raymond in his office after she leaves.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Sonny Burch wants Hank Pym's lab for its quantum technology and chases Scott Lang and Hope van Dyne across San Francisco to get it. His hunt ends with him and his men under arrest.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Scott Lang, a big fan of Captain America, is recruited to fight on Steve Rogers' side against the Sokovia Accords and is locked up on the Raft for it.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Five years after the Snap, Scott turns up at the Avengers compound with the idea that leads Steve to the time heist.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Thaddeus Ross has Scott locked in the Raft after the airport battle.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Scott takes a deal from Ross that puts him under house arrest so he can stay near his daughter.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Scott Lang fights against Tony Stark at the Leipzig airport, growing into Giant-Man before Tony and Rhodey bring him down.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Five years later Scott's escape from the Quantum Realm sets Tony on the path to time travel, and they team up to steal the Tesseract in 2012 New York.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Selby works in Madripoor for the Power Broker, who is secretly Sharon. When Zemo's cover is blown and Selby orders him, Sam and Bucky killed, Sharon shoots her from a sniper's perch.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Selby knows that Wilfred Nagel is the scientist behind the new super soldier serum and that he is hiding in Madripoor. She warns Zemo that he will never find Nagel without her.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Senator Stern grills Tony Stark at a Senate hearing and demands he hand over the Iron Man armor, which Tony flatly refuses. Later Stern has to pin a medal on Tony, through gritted teeth.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Sprite is Sersi's close friend and lives with her in London. She sides with Ikaris against Sersi, and in the end Sersi makes her human.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Thena fights at Sersi's side as one of the Eternals, and Sersi brings her into the fight to stop the Emergence.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett tips off Shades and Tone that Chico Diaz is hiding in Pop's Barber Shop. The tip leads straight to the shooting that kills Pop.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Zip works alongside Shades in Cottonmouth's crew and drifts between bosses after Cottonmouth dies. When Zip is sent to kill Shades, Shades overpowers him and kills him instead.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Shang-Chi kills the Dweller-in-Darkness with the Ten Rings after it breaks out of the Dark Gate.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Trevor Slattery is a prisoner in Wenwu's compound. He joins Shang-Chi on the journey to Ta Lo.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Wenwu is Shang-Chi's father. He trains his son as an assassin, and later he fights him at the gate in Ta Lo before giving him the Ten Rings as he dies.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Wong steps through a portal after the battle at Ta Lo and brings Shang-Chi and Katy to Kamar-Taj to study the Ten Rings.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Xialing is Shang-Chi's younger sister. She resents him for leaving her behind, but they fight side by side against their father and the Dweller-in-Darkness.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Ying Nan is Shang-Chi's aunt, his mother's sister. She welcomes him to Ta Lo and trains him in his mother's fighting style.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Sharon Carter is a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who guards Steve Rogers while posing as his neighbor, and she stands with him when Hydra is exposed.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Sharon helps Steve and Sam get their gear back while they are on the run, and the two share a kiss.

stages.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
stages.text: Wilfred Nagel works for the Power Broker, who is secretly Sharon Carter.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Under Wanda's spell, Sharon Davis plays Mrs. Hart, the wife of Vision's boss. She and her husband come to dinner at Vision and Wanda's home.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Wanda keeps Sharon Davis under mind control inside the Westview Hex, where she is made to play Mrs. Hart.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Sheila Rivera runs Wilson Fisk's mayoral campaign and then serves as his chief of staff.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: In the end Sheila breaks with Fisk, and once he is gone she takes over as interim mayor of New York.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Shuri is T'Chaka's youngest child. After his death, she learns from T'Challa that their father killed their uncle N'Jobu in Oakland.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Shuri is T'Challa's younger sister and Wakanda's brightest inventor, who builds his suits and gadgets.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: After T'Challa's death, Shuri grieves her brother and takes up the mantle of Black Panther.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Shuri is Toussaint's aunt. She meets him for the first time in Haiti during the mourning ceremony for T'Challa.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: In Wakanda, Shuri attempts to remove the Mind Stone from Vision's head without killing him. Corvus Glaive attacks before she can finish.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: W'Kabi turns against Shuri's family when he backs Erik Killmonger's claim to the throne. During the battle at Mount Bashenga, his Border Tribe corners Shuri, Okoye, Nakia and Ayo behind energy shields.

stages.title: Thor: The Dark World
stages.text: Sif and Volstagg deliver the Aether to the Collector on Knowhere, since it is unwise to keep two Infinity Stones together in Asgard. The Collector promises it will be safe in his collection, and Sif tells him to see that it is.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Sif fights alongside the Warriors Three as Thor's closest companions. Together they join his raid on Jotunheim and travel to Earth to bring him home.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Sif and Thor are close friends from childhood who fight side by side as warriors of Asgard.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
stages.text: Lady Sif is sent to capture Vin-Tak and ends up working with him for a time.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: The Silver Surfer, herald of Galactus, announces Earth's doom to Sue and the team. She later turns against Galactus.

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Trevor Slattery is sent by Damage Control to trick Simon into exposing his powers. Instead he becomes Simon's best friend and helps him land the role of Wonder Man.

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Von Kovak is the director remaking Wonder Man. Simon auditions for him and wins his dream role.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Sinister Strange is a variant of Stephen whose use of the Darkhold destroyed his own universe. When Stephen is stranded there, Sinister Strange attacks him over the Darkhold, and Stephen kills him in a duel fought with musical notes.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Skully is close to Maya's mother Taloa, asking Chula how to sign words so he can share his stories with Taloa by the fire. He is with Chula the night Taloa is killed in a car crash, and comforts William at the hospital the next day.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Wilson Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force wrongly arrests Soledad Ayala and holds her at the Freeport.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Uzman is a former MI6 agent whom Sonny Burch hires for his crew. Burch has him dose Luis with a truth serum to find out where Hank Pym's lab is hidden.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Soren is Talos' wife and the mother of their daughter G'iah.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Gravik murders Soren, and her last words urge Talos to find their daughter G'iah.

stages.title: The Defenders
stages.text: Sowande has fought Stick many times over the years. Stick finally kills him.

stages.title: Eternals
stages.text: Thena and Sprite fight the Deviants together for thousands of years, and in ancient Athens Sprite spreads tales of Thena as the goddess of war. Their bond breaks when Sprite sides with Ikaris to let the Emergence go ahead.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Stakar Ogord frees Yondu Udonta from slavery and takes him into the Ravagers. He later exiles Yondu for trafficking children.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Stephen Strange hands Thanos the Time Stone to save Tony Stark, knowing it is the one path to victory.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: The Ancient One takes Stephen Strange in at Kamar-Taj after the accident that ruins his hands and teaches him the mystic arts, knowing he is meant to succeed her. Before she dies, she tells him that sometimes the rules have to be broken for the greater good.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Stephen Strange and Tony Stark butt heads as two big egos when Thanos' forces reach New York, then fight Thanos together on Titan. Strange gives up the Time Stone to save Tony's life, knowing Tony is the key to the one future where they win.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Stephen Strange asks Wanda for help protecting America Chavez, only to learn that she is the one hunting her. Corrupted by the Darkhold, Wanda besieges Kamar-Taj and chases Strange across the multiverse to take America's power.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Wong is the librarian of Kamar-Taj who helps teach Stephen Strange, and they become close friends.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: While Strange is lost in the Blip, Wong takes over as Sorcerer Supreme, and he warns Strange against casting the spell to make the world forget Peter Parker.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: T'Challa hunts Bucky Barnes for his father's murder and fights Steve Rogers to get to him in Bucharest and Leipzig.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Having learned that Zemo was behind his father's death, T'Challa shelters Steve and Bucky in Wakanda, and they fight side by side when Thanos' army invades.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: As Secretary of State, Thaddeus Ross presses the Sokovia Accords on Steve Rogers and then locks up the Avengers who sided with him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Steve Rogers leads the Avengers against Thanos in Wakanda but cannot stop the Snap.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Five years later Steve faces Thanos alone with Mjolnir and then rallies everyone for the final battle.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Steve Rogers recruits the Howling Commandos from the men he freed from HYDRA's prison camp and leads them across Europe. Together they tear down HYDRA's bases one by one.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Steve Rogers and Thor come to blows when they first meet, then fight together as founding Avengers.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: In the Battle of Earth, Steve proves himself worthy and wields Thor's hammer Mjolnir, to Thor's delight.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Tony Stark and Steve Rogers clash from the start, but they fight side by side as founding Avengers in the Battle of New York.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: They split apart over the Sokovia Accords. When Tony learns Bucky killed his parents, he turns on Steve and Bucky in Siberia, and Steve leaves his shield behind.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Tony and Steve make peace before the time heist and fight together in the final battle against Thanos.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Steve Rogers leads the Avengers against Ultron, from the fight over the cradle in Seoul to the Battle of Sokovia. Ultron mocks Steve as God's righteous man, pretending he could live without a war.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Steve Rogers leads Vision on the new Avengers after Sokovia.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: They end up on opposite sides over the Sokovia Accords.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Steve and Vision reunite to protect Vision and his Mind Stone from Thanos' forces.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Before she switches sides in the fight against Ultron, Wanda traps Steve Rogers in visions of his past. After Sokovia, he trains her on the new Avengers.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Wanda sides with Steve against the Sokovia Accords and fights for him at the Leipzig airport.

stages.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
stages.text: Years after Galactus is defeated, Sue finds Victor von Doom sitting with her son Franklin.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Yon-Rogg commands Starforce with fierce loyalty to the Supreme Intelligence, the AI that rules the Kree. He brings Carol Danvers before it to keep her under control, and after she breaks free he is sent back to Hala in defeat with her warning for it.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Thor escapes Surtur in Muspelheim and takes his crown. Later he brings Surtur back to destroy Asgard and stop Hela.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Sylvie learns Victor Timely is a variant of He Who Remains and hunts him down to kill him before he can become the same tyrant. She spares him in the end, and he goes to the TVA to try to save the Temporal Loom.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: T'Chaka is T'Challa's father and the king of Wakanda. When T'Chaka is killed in Vienna, T'Challa becomes king.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: T'Challa learns that his father killed his own brother N'Jobu and left N'Jobu's son behind, and he vows not to repeat T'Chaka's mistakes.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Toussaint is the son of T'Challa and Nakia, which makes T'Chaka his grandfather. T'Chaka dies years before the boy is born, so they never meet.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Ulysses Klaue steals vibranium from T'Chaka's Wakanda in 1992, killing many Wakandans with help from T'Chaka's own brother N'Jobu. Uncovering that betrayal leads T'Chaka to confront and kill N'Jobu.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: W'Kabi sits on the Tribal Council under King T'Chaka, but he never forgives him for failing to bring Ulysses Klaue to justice after Klaue's attack killed W'Kabi's parents.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Zuri works undercover for King T'Chaka, posing as N'Jobu's friend James to spy on him in Oakland. After T'Chaka kills N'Jobu, Zuri keeps the king's secret for decades.

stages.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
stages.text: Toussaint is the son of T'Challa and Nakia, raised in Haiti.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Ulysses Klaue stole vibranium from Wakanda and killed many of its people, and T'Challa hunts him to bring him home for justice. T'Challa catches him in Busan, but Killmonger breaks him out and later kills him to win his way into Wakanda.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: T'Challa and his people protect Vision in Wakanda while Shuri works on the Mind Stone.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: W'Kabi is T'Challa's best friend and a leader of the Border Tribe. Bitter that T'Challa fails to bring back Klaue, who killed his parents, he backs Killmonger and leads his tribe against T'Challa.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: At the airport battle, Wanda stops T'Challa's claws just short of Bucky's throat and throws him aside.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Two years later, T'Challa's Wakanda shelters Wanda and Vision as the Avengers make their stand against Thanos.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Zuri is T'Challa's mentor and a trusted elder of Wakanda. He dies shielding T'Challa from Killmonger.

stages.title: Eyes of Wakanda
stages.text: The Black Panther of the future travels back to 1896 to stop a vibranium axe from being recovered, and she clashes with Tafari.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Varra is a fellow Skrull and an old friend of Talos. After his death she helps G'iah give him a traditional Skrull funeral.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Yon-Rogg leads Starforce in hunting Talos and his Skrull refugees. He kills Mar-Vell to stop her from helping them and later captures Talos's people at her hidden lab.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Fisk forces FBI chief Tammy Hattley to work for him by having one of her children killed and threatening the rest.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Taserface leads a mutiny against Yondu Udonta and kills Yondu's loyal crew.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine hires Taskmaster as one of her operatives, then sends her on a mission meant to kill her.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Taskmaster hunts Yelena Belova and the other Red Room escapees for Dreykov.

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Ted, the Man-Thing, is the creature the hunters are set loose to kill.

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Verussa Bloodstone keeps Ted, the Man-Thing, prisoner. Once he is freed, he kills her.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: The High Evolutionary experiments on Teefs, and Teefs is shot dead by his guards during the escape.

stages.title: The Incredible Hulk
stages.text: Tony Stark approaches General Ross in a bar about his Hulk problem and tells him a team is being put together.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Years later Tony backs Secretary Ross' Sokovia Accords and hunts down Steve's side, but he grows uneasy when Ross locks his old teammates in the Raft and goes behind Ross' back to help Steve in Siberia.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Thaddeus Ross presents the Sokovia Accords to the Avengers, using Wanda's accident in Lagos as proof they need oversight. After she sides with Steve, Ross has her locked up in the Raft.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Thanos takes the Reality Stone from the Collector on Knowhere.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: The Other is Thanos' servant who speaks for him and hands Loki the Chitauri army to invade Earth.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: After the invasion fails, the Other keeps serving Thanos until Ronan kills him in a rage.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Thanos kills Loki and much of Asgard's people aboard their refugee ship. Thor hits Thanos with Stormbreaker in Wakanda but cannot stop the Snap.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Weeks later Thor finds Thanos on his farm planet and beheads him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Tony Stark fights Thanos on Titan and fails to stop him.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Five years later Tony takes the Infinity Stones from Thanos and snaps him out of existence, at the cost of his own life.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Valkyrie is one of the few Asgardians to survive Thanos' attack on the Statesman, and she leads the refugees to safety. Five years later she rides into the Battle of Earth on her winged horse to fight his army.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Thanos sends the Black Order after the Mind Stone in Vision's head. When Wanda destroys the Stone to stop him, Thanos turns back time with the Time Stone, rips it from Vision's head and kills him.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Wanda Maximoff destroys the Mind Stone to keep it from Thanos, but he turns back time, tears it from Vision and kills him in front of her.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Five years later, Wanda confronts Thanos in the final battle and nearly kills him.

stages.title: Doctor Strange
stages.text: Wong serves the Ancient One at Kamar-Taj as a master and keeper of its library, reporting to her when Strange takes restricted books. After her death he worries that Earth has no Sorcerer Supreme.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: The Collector and the Grandmaster are brothers. Both gather living beings for their own amusement, the Collector in his museum on Knowhere and the Grandmaster in his gladiator arena on Sakaar.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: The Dweller-in-Darkness tricks Wenwu with his wife's voice into trying to open its prison. It kills him once it gets free.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Ying Nan leads Ta Lo in its long watch over the Dweller-in-Darkness and fights it when it breaks free.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: The Grandmaster takes Thor as a gladiator and pits him against the Hulk in his Contest of Champions. Thor escapes Sakaar with Valkyrie and Bruce in the Grandmaster's ship.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Topaz is the Grandmaster's bodyguard and the head of his guards on Sakaar, always ready with the melt stick when he wants someone gone. When his champion escapes, he sends her to hunt down Bruce Banner and Valkyrie.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Valkyrie works for the Grandmaster as Scrapper 142, catching fighters for him, and she later turns on him.

stages.title: Ironheart
stages.text: Zelma Stanton enchants Riri's armor so that Riri can fight the Hood on equal terms.

stages.title: Werewolf by Night
stages.text: Verussa Bloodstone gathers the monster hunters at Bloodstone Manor and sets the hunt for the Bloodstone.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Tucker Shockley is the right-hand man of the Superior, Anton Ivanov, in the Watchdogs. When Senator Nadeer hesitates to kill her Inhuman brother, Ivanov sends Shockley to finish the job, and Shockley stays loyal even after learning he is an Inhuman himself.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Adrian Toomes resents Tony Stark after Stark's Damage Control takes his salvage contract.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: The Warriors Three are Thor's closest companions in battle, joining his reckless raid on Jotunheim and later coming to Earth to bring him home.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: After years at Thor's side, including helping him smuggle Jane and Loki out of Asgard, the Warriors Three are killed by Hela when she seizes the throne.

stages.title: Black Widow
stages.text: Yelena is one of Dreykov's Black Widows until the Red Dust frees her from his mind control. She then fights to free the rest of them, and sets out to find the Widows still under his control around the world.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Tony Stark and Thor come to blows when they first meet, then fight together as founding Avengers.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the Snap they team up again for the time heist and stand together in the final battle against Thanos.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Toothgnasher and Toothgrinder are giant goats given to Thor as a gift. They pull his ship across the sky to Omnipotence City and back.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Topaz serves the Grandmaster while Thor is forced to fight on Sakaar, and she chases him when he escapes.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Thor fights Ultron from the moment the robot crashes the Avengers' party to the Battle of Sokovia. After seeing a vision of the Infinity Stones, Thor brings Vision to life with lightning, and Vision helps the team destroy Ultron.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Valkyrie captures Thor on Sakaar and sells him to the Grandmaster, then joins him to fight Hela.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: After the war with Thanos, Thor leaves New Asgard in her hands as its new king.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Thor uses Mjolnir's lightning to bring Vision to life, trusting what the Mind Stone showed him. Vision proves himself by lifting Mjolnir and handing it back to Thor.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Before she switches sides, Wanda traps Thor in a nightmare vision of Asgard, which sends him looking for answers and leads him to help bring Vision to life. They then fight side by side in the Battle of Sokovia.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Thor once admired Zeus, but Zeus refuses to help against Gorr and tries to hold him captive. Thor takes his Thunderbolt.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Tyler Hayward opens fire on Tommy and Billy Maximoff, and Monica Rambeau steps in to save them.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Ultron is a prisoner inside White Vision's mind. When he tricks Vision into giving up control of his body, he takes Tommy.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Tommy is the son of Wanda and the Vision she recreates in the Hex.

stages.title: VisionQuest
stages.text: Years later White Vision, who first hunts Tommy, becomes a father figure to him.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Tommy Maximoff is one of the twin sons Wanda Maximoff creates with her magic in Westview. When she brings down the hex, she has to let him go.

stages.title: Luke Cage S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett texts Tone, Cottonmouth's bodyguard, to tell him where Chico Diaz is hiding.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Tony Stark builds Ultron to protect the world, but Ultron turns on him and the Avengers and tries to wipe out humanity.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Tony Stark once nearly sold Stark Industries weapons to arms dealer Ulysses Klaue, so he knows Klaue is the man Strucker's trail leads to. The Avengers track Klaue to his salvage ship just after Ultron cuts off his arm.

stages.title: Iron Man 3
stages.text: Vice President Rodriguez secretly backs Aldrich Killian's plot against Tony Stark and the President, in exchange for Extremis to heal his daughter. He is arrested once Tony and Rhodey stop Killian.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Tony Stark and Bruce Banner bring Vision to life by uploading what is left of J.A.R.V.I.S. into a synthetic body, and Vision fights beside Tony against Ultron.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Vision sides with Tony over the Sokovia Accords and fights for him at the Leipzig airport.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Wanda Maximoff blames Tony Stark for her parents' deaths, since a Stark shell left her trapped in the rubble as a child, and she plants the vision that drives him to build Ultron.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Wanda is now an Avenger, but Tony has her kept at the compound under the Sokovia Accords, and she sides with Steve against him.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: William Ginter Riva is a Stark Industries scientist who fails to rebuild Tony Stark's miniature arc reactor for Obadiah Stane, who reminds him Tony built one in a cave.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Feeling overlooked by the company, Riva later helps Quentin Beck scheme against Tony's legacy.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Wong and Tony Stark team up with Stephen Strange against Ebony Maw and Cull Obsidian in New York. Wong saves Tony by sending Cull Obsidian through a portal to Antarctica.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Topaz, the Grandmaster's bodyguard, openly despises Valkyrie and calls her trash when she delivers Thor. When Valkyrie helps lead the rebellion on Sakaar, Topaz reports it to the Grandmaster and joins the chase.

stages.title: Wonder Man
stages.text: Trevor Slattery wins over the director Von Kovak and lands a part alongside Simon in the Wonder Man remake.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Trevor Slattery played a fake version of the Mandarin, and Wenwu has him locked up for it.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Xialing breaks Trevor out of Wenwu's cell along with Shang-Chi and Katy, and they escape in Razor Fist's car to Ta Lo.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Will Simpson tries to kill Trish while under Kilgrave's control. Afterward they start a romance that ends when he becomes violent.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett does business with Vladimir's Russian mob before they turn on each other.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Turk Barrett runs jobs for Fisk's organization, including a human trafficking shipment. He is arrested when Fisk's operation is exposed.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel
stages.text: Tyesha Hillman marries Yusuf's son Aamir, making her Yusuf's daughter-in-law.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Tyler Hayward takes Vision's body after his death, refuses to let Wanda bury him, and spends years trying to rebuild him as a S.W.O.R.D. weapon. Using energy from Westview, he finally brings him back as the White Vision and sends him to destroy Wanda's Vision.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Tyler Hayward treats Wanda Maximoff as a threat. He fires a missile at her and builds the White Vision to use against her.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Ultron buys Ulysses Klaue's entire stock of vibranium for his plan. When Klaue compares him to Tony Stark, Ultron flies into a rage and cuts off his arm.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Vision is created from the body Ultron built for himself, and he destroys Ultron's last body.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Wanda and Pietro join Ultron to take revenge on Tony Stark. When Wanda sees that he plans to wipe out humanity, she turns on him, and after he kills Pietro she rips out his core.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: W'Kabi's parents die in Ulysses Klaue's 1992 raid on Wakanda, and he spends years wanting the man caught. When Erik Killmonger arrives with Klaue's body, W'Kabi throws his support behind Erik.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Wanda Maximoff and her brother storm Ulysses Klaue's salvage yard ahead of Ultron's vibranium deal. Klaue mocks them for their youth, taunts them about Strucker's death and tells Wanda that anyone who fiddles with his brain is not the one in charge.

stages.title: Black Widow (Post-Credits Scene)
stages.text: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine recruits Yelena Belova after Natasha's death and sends her after Clint Barton, the man she blames.

stages.title: Thunderbolts*
stages.text: Yelena keeps doing Valentina's dirty work until Valentina tries to have her killed to cover up her own crimes.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Valkyrie fights her way out of Zeus's palace and takes his Thunderbolt as her weapon.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Wilson Fisk falls in love with art dealer Vanessa Marianna, and she stands by him even after learning what he is.

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Fisk marries Vanessa after his release, and she becomes his partner in both life and crime.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Vernon Masters serves the Council of Nine and takes his orders from Whitney Frost once she seizes control of it. He breaks with her by striking a deal with Jack Thompson, Peggy Carter and Daniel Sousa.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Vision is born in the fight against Ultron and carries Wanda to safety as Sokovia falls.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Vision and Wanda grow close at the Avengers Compound, though he keeps her there under the Sokovia Accords.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Vision and Wanda fall in love. She is forced to destroy him to keep the Mind Stone from Thanos.

stages.title: WandaVision
stages.text: Wanda's grief gives rise to Westview, where she conjures a new Vision and a life with him.

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Vladimir Ranskahov partners with Fisk until Fisk murders his brother Anatoly. Vladimir then turns on Fisk and dies fighting his men.

stages.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
stages.text: Wanda lays siege to Kamar-Taj while hunting America Chavez and knocks Wong aside. She captures him and forces him to lead her to Mount Wundagore, where he reveals the Darkhold's origins to spare the other sorcerers.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Wenwu is Xialing's father. He ignores her as a child, and she takes over the Ten Rings after his death.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Wenwu is Ying Nan's brother-in-law. She fights him and his army when he attacks Ta Lo to open the Dark Gate.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Zane is one of Fisk's men in Oklahoma. Fisk orders him to stand down just before he executes Maya Lopez and her uncle.

stages.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
stages.text: Ying Nan is Xialing's aunt, her mother's sister, and welcomes her to Ta Lo.
